_what_this_is: The invariant violations the adversarial QA harness found in the corpus, written down
so the test suite can stay green while the defects stay visible.
It is a ledger, not an excuse list. The test that reads it fails in BOTH directions:
an entry here that stops violating fails (somebody fixed it - remove the entry), and a
violation that is not here fails (something new broke). Neither direction can pass
quietly, which is the only thing that stops a file like this becoming a place where
IT IS NOW EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE POINT.
